I can't believe how well this one turned out, wow it really makes the game a lot better. Spent the better half of tonight doing and testing this and for fans of the Thief class you're gonna' love it!


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Thieves can now steal from shops![/b] I wasn't sure how I was going to get this to work but holy crap it's pretty cool. Here are the requirements:

-You must be level 7 or higher (the green sprite w/ the hat  and the money bag)
-You must have at least one spot in your backpack
-You must have a clean record with the shops (more on this in a sec)

A new screen will pop up with the item you've selected, your chances of stealing it without getting caught, and the option to steal it "YES" or "NO". notes.title: Improved Flee & More!

[list]

notes.title: Tutorial Added!
notes.content:
Back so soon!

A few people have been doing Let's Plays of the game and a common theme I observed seemed to be a lot of "What's this do?" or "What's that stand for?" Now I'm all for a game having a fair share of secrets however the player should know what HST stands for or what that orange bar under your HUD means without being a part-time Swamii ːsteamfacepalmː


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*]To that end, I've (finally) made a pretty decent tutorial section! It took approx. 12 hours over the past 2 days. This replaces the 'Official Guides' part of the start menu. I figure hey we're all on Steam anyhow and we know where to find them if we need to.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/1094ae7c9b9f5ea303241df23074c95df560ff6b.jpg[/img]

The Tutorial goes over about 40 different aspects of gameplay, and includes stuff that will be really helpful to anybody new to the game (as well as some vets too perhaps!).

You can move through the pages using your arrow keys / controller, and the cancel key / button to return to the start menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/3aa596e4dadac906d4c0927b2b8a5bb7b7eb9868.jpg[/img]


[*]I've also added a blue border background on the 'Known Tips' page.
[/list]


[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

None this time



[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*]I believe I've made it so that barrels, flowers, and chests can't spawn right next to a shop / guild door anymore. I guess we'll see!

[*]There was a rare bug ErickaUnlimited reported having where upon entering a shop she sometimes would immediately exit it. I couldn't duplicate the problem but have added a couple of safety nets in there which should prevent it again.
[/list]

notes.title: Easter Update Pack!!
notes.content:
Did you think only those cute and cuddly furry bunnies would make an appearance today? 
No! Here comes our gray sharkskin covered variety with a challenging new update for all!

It's a good one, so read on:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/e9c6bfdaa454996c6d8f82622dc23445c5023a33.jpg[/img]
[i]No Easter Sunday is ever safe for this poor bastard..[/i]


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]The Lantern Grows in Power!![/b]
Ryan wrote a great review on ETL the other day, and one of his gripes was that it seemed as if the titular Lantern didn't really do enough to warrant him caring enough. And we can't have that! 
So, without giving TOO much away, I will tell you that the different color phases now either increase or decrease the odds that specific floor events can happen. Ah hell, I'll spoil one: Inferno Floors have a higher chance of appearing during the Red Phase. OK OK that's enough, figure the rest out yourselves ːsteamhappyː

[*]New Floor Event.... The Trap Floor! When active, its powers will conceal every flashing red trapped chest on the floor... And you won't know if it's safe to open until you try it!! Thankfully, this will have NO EFFECT on the Thief class, who can see right through the Lantern's deception. The good news is that the power of a Trap Floor also raises the quality of the items inside each chest and barrel by a small amount. This tricky event can happen anytime from floors 11+

[*][b]Variants![/b]
I'm happy to say the new Variant scheme is also in place. What that means, is that 25% of the time the floor may spawn with different versions of the following:

[b]Slime-Covered Cauldrons[/b] will almost always give you much better potions when you fill your empty bottles up. The effect stacks with the Alchemy Hat, should you be wearing it.

[b]Ghost Flames[/b] are new, blue, ghosty-like fires that can spawn in place of normal fires. Unlike normal fires though, stepping on one will not burn your wooden gear into ashes. Also unlike normal fires they will injure you for a whopping 3HP (vs. 1HP with regular fires).

[b]Toadstools[/b] are purple fungi that can grow in dark or damp places. The odds of eating a poisonous one are just the same as regular mushrooms, but the effects are far stronger. So eat one and you may gain lots of HP... Or poison yourself for some pretty big damage over time. As always, consuming the Foot Powder item will negate the poison effect from your body.

[b]Bloody Floor Spikes[/b] are just like the regular spike traps that spawn in the mid-game, only damage you for 2HP per whack. Remember to use that WAIT command until the spikes retract to avoid this damage, folks!!

[*]I've changed the 'Stretch' screen option to 'Full' screen. Now let me explain: I think it makes things look a LITTLE better, but it's not too much of a difference and I'd still recommend playing ETL with either the Default or Large windowed screen. But it's in there. Again, since the original size of the game frame is only 120 x 100 pixels there's not too much I can really do to increase the resolution at this point in the game, 6+ years later.

[*]New Daily Bonus: April Fool's Day. Why that's TODAY!! Get to it!

[*]A couple new sayings when you start a new game were added.

[/list]


[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*]WARRIOR NERF-O-RAMA. Yes, I know this may sadden some of you however honestly the guy was just way too OP. Roguelikes are s'posed to be challenging of course! Here's what's new about this class:

Upon leveling up- and in keeping with his Magic Prone trait- Warriors will lose -1 MDEF. So as they grow into a melee ass kicking machine they do so at the cost of becoming more and more susceptible to all things magic,.

Warriors now also have the Butter Fingers trait. That means upon setting off a chest trap they'll take 1-2 more damage than usual. That also means that he'll have a +5% better chance to break an item when trying to use it (re-usable items only; consumables will still work 100% of the time like everyone else).

[*]The "Gear Burned Away!" display was made a little easier to see, should it happen to you in battle.

[*]The Cultist's "$500 Donation" option at the Cultist Den has been improved. Now, you have a chance to gain 0-2 points in each stat when you donate (vs. the old way which was 0-1 points per stat). Same great cost, way better reward. Cultists are hard enough to play as it is ːsteamsaltyː

[*]The Warrior and Thief class descriptions were changed a bit to accomodate the Warrior's new weakness and the Thief's new strength (vs. a Trap Floor).
[/list]


[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*]Only one this time. I tried to take a screenshot of my Game Over screen and upon pressing the keyboard it jumped to the title screen too quickly. You should now be able to press and take F12 screenshots ALL THE LIVE LONG DAY from the death screen. Hooray!
[/list]

---

And that's about it. Overall, I've made the game harder but I've kept it closer to my original vision: A nice, deep but accessible graphical roguelike that retains its challenge and rewards its loyal playerbase.

And as always, more free content and updates for that low $3 price point. I mean holy shit, right?

Happy Easter, and here's what happened to me yesterday when a Time Bomb went off:


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/ec11ec9bc44d84c1f83440fff5a8e584f463138e.jpg[/img]
[i]Even I, Del_Duio, am not immune to The Lantern's ASSHOLE-ERY.[/i]

notes.title: A Nice One!
notes.content:
Here's a nice little update which should live up to the title "A NICE ONE" just.. ah.. nicely!

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

I've read in a couple places prior that some people had said that the RNG could sometimes be a bit unfair in the game. More specifically, they might not have chosen a weapon for their starter items and went many floors without getting one from a chest and etc. 

Today's patch takes care of these concerns a bit. On floors 7 and 9 if you open a regular chest and are unarmed you'll always get a weapon from it that one time. Now it won't be a damned Dragonslayer or anything, but it'll be better than punching the enemy to death. There are a few new checks in place so that this can't be totally exploted- Because I'm sure it might be by somebody- but to me the positives outweigh the potential bad apple trying to cheat or whatever.


[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

The regular Pickaxe is now Cultist-usable. I know it's not a knife but it just seemed a bit strange that it's the one really useful tool that she couldn't use before. As for the much stronger War Pick, that's still off-limits to our evil friend.

Lower floor dimensional rifts now are capped on how many monsters come out. The cap is a lot lower than it used to be, so super OP characters can't feed off unlimited champs anymore. I find this to keep the challenge on par for where I want it to be at those depths.

Viewing rotten food as a Cultist now shows the actual benefits of eating them. Before it would give you the HP and STM boosts but still show as being harmful to eat. Since the Cultist has the "Iron Stomach" perk by default, this change makes more sense.

The little bones you see on the ground have slightly different / better graphics. Go on, take a look. You know you want to.

The Left Hand and Right Hand icons when you view your gear have been reverted back to normal. I did this because if you looked at something that your character couldn't use you'd have a flashing hand, then a big "R" (or "L"), and then a big "NO" too. And it was wonky and blah. Not anymore.



[h1]FIXES[/h1]

The Champ and Boss Death Magic resistances mentioned in the last patch turned out to be broken and didn't work right. They do now! To reiterate, All champs get a +5% death magic resistance and bosses get +15%.

__

And that's about it! 
Until next time, good Friday and all that!

-Del_Duio

notes.title: The Fix is In!
notes.content:
Hello!

I know everybody is probably sleeping however it's time for a late night hotfix! Most of these address some balance but I've finally solved the enemy freezing issue with a lot of help from ETL super player Gasil.

Without further ado... READ ON:


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

None. For probably the first time ever!


[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*]The RITUAL skill's damage has been slightly nerfed. Instead of incorporating the Cultist's full DEX value it's now half DEX value.

[*]The DEATH spell's chance of success has been increased by 10%, however all champ monsters get a 5% resistance to it and bosses get 15%. What this effectively does is make the spell work better on regular enemies and - while it can still take out the game's bosses in a single blow - makes it slightly less possible. And when you think about it, how many games even LET you use something like an instant death spell on big bosses?

For those who are interested, the chance of DEATH's success is:

[i]If Random(100) <= (40 + MAG) - Enemy Death Resistance Then [b]dead parrot[/b][/i]

[*]Enemies coming out of late floor dimensional rifts have been capped.. sort of. What I mean is enemies will constantly continue to appear from these as long as the total enemy count is less than Int(Dungeon Floor / 2). So at floor 40 dimensional enemies will appear if there's already less than 20 enemies. So you can still have a ton of enemies, just not hundreds or anything too nuts.

[*]When an enemy steals an item from your backpack it is now added to its own backpack. If you're a thief and try to steal from it there'll be a chance you can get your stolen item back. Very handy if a Mugger just stole your Weebish Blade!
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*]The rare yet nasty battle freeze bug appears to have been fixed now! I could never figure out just why this would sometimes happen but after Gasil discovered how to mega level a Thief up, dodge in battle, and use lots of high evasion gear he summised that it had to do with the Thief's ultimate ability to just be way too good at dodging everything. 

Turns out he was right! There was a couple lines of code where the equation wouldn't make any sense if you had mega DEX and super high evasion, if you also dodged during battle. The enemy's equations never made sense, and the game would hang because of it. The way I fixed it was that an enemy can never have below a 5% chance to hit, regardless of stats or gear or anything else. After testing it tonight, it appears to have solved the problem!

[*]A couple of enemies had a "Speed Potion" as a possible item to be stolen from during fights. This is great, except that's OLD CODING and I had since changed the item's name to "Potion of Speed"! So if you stole a Speed Potion the game didn't recognize it and didn't give it its own picture or stats, instead displaying the values of the last item in your backpack you last looked at. Though certainly not game-breaking like the evasion freeze bug above, this had to be fixed as well and now it has.
[/list]

--

And that's all for tonight, thank you Gasil for finding these for me and awesome job being the first to win the game with the Cultist!

notes.title: New Expansion: Cult of the Dragon King!!
notes.content:
Well it's been a long time (for me) but it's finally available. I present to you all now the largest and most likely last major expansion to my game, "Cult of the Dragon King"!

There are many many changes and additions so bear with me and listen to me blab all about it for an eternity now:

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*]New class: The Cultist! The cultist now joins the others as the fifth playable character in the game. And for equal opportunity and all that it's a little girl! Now she plays a lot differently than the others so listen up-

+ Has very powerful dark offensive skills
+ Can eat rotten food unharmed, and gains double the stamina from said food
+ Gets a 50% Max HP discount when visiting a Cultist Den
+ Can donate $500 in gold there, with a possibility of gaining some stats
+ Gains the Instant Kill effect on the Yellow phase
- Has serious gear restrictions and in fact can only use daggers, knives, and etc along with clothes and robes
- Is physically pitiful, and gains stats and levels very slowly
- She's reviled by most everyone in the dungeon, and is not welcomed at shops or guilds

This is also the sole class that starts off being locked away to the player. To unlock the cultist class, you'll need to find 50% or more of the game's items. You can easily check your progress in the Items Found Log on the start menu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/671d1905d4401807bd5265fa3fcaf9c594fa0030.jpg[/img]

[*]New Floor Event: Disruption Floor! This magic power scrambles the magnetic fields of the dungeon, causing all your controls to be reversed while moving around and negating your compass!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/d410f861310bbef7efa34ffc850f6b96a7bc9c3b.jpg[/img]

[*]New Floor Event: Coven Floor! It's now possible to visit an entire floor full of members of the Cult of the Dragon King while playing! Here you'll find cultists and high priests, and if you're really unlucky you might run into the Dragon King himself! This floor is also unique to the game in that there are new specific items that can only be found within locked golden and shadow chests here too.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/f13791b617ce88706837e8774a350df15bea6271.jpg[/img]

[*]40 New items!! This now means my little game boasts a whopping 400 total! That's pretty friggin' good I think ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/95844bc4491431945fca2d396f259f1be5909b24.jpg[/img]

[*]15 New maps!! Always a good idea to make more of these.

[*]New item class: Rotten Food! The game now also has a few items that are.. ah.. past their prime. Rotten food will hurt your HP yet heal your stamina a bit. Think of these as a last resort. If you're playing a cultist though, they'll get healed the HP and take double the stamina from this nasty crap.

[*]Improved Chamber of Heroes! It's hard to get to, so I made the Chamber of Heroes way better than it was before. It'll totally be worth it now.

[*]Class selection now has a small description for each! Unsure what a wizard does? Select him from the character select screen and a pop up appears, letting you know all about it. There's one for everybody. Go on, try it now and see!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/8b113fa70047b13d72caf2c99ed782c59ac74bef.jpg[/img]

[*]New HUD addition for people who are color blind! It's unlikely but I thought hey what if somebody who was color blind tried to play this game? They'd need to know what lantern phase was currently active, right? Well now it's plain spelled out and abbreviated above the HP / STM display on the main screen. And you know what? I think it flat out looks way better for everyone!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/839151e46c1cee2151f5a465a542c98ece89bac6.jpg[/img]

[*]New Enemies: Zombie, Wraith, Cultist, High Priest.

[*]New major boss: Dragon King! This guy is the real deal:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/be9c64230aed14e98ddec4cdc58e6d871e75c5f1.jpg[/img]

[*]If you're equipped with wooden gear it will now warn you you're fire prone on the special screen, along with the qty of items in fire peril.

[*]Class inate abilities are now listed on the special screen too. For example a Warrior is Magic Prone while the Thief gains a bonus to avoid ambushes.

[*]1 New Achievement where you have to win the game as a Cultist. It's listed as hidden just in case somebody doesn't read this later and wants to be surprised.
[/list]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]I've gone back and changed it so that now you'll only see the USE command when an item can actually be used while inspecting it. This takes a lot of the guesswork out of seeing what does what. This works for me however like any big change if you have any issues please let me know in the forums!

Here's an example, the "USE" no longer shows up for things like this-

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/ab30c05928bf5827436832db0c8842102c6dcb08.jpg[/img]

[*]As mentioned above, the lantern color indicator on the backpack screen has been changed to match the HUD but the color's name is fully spelled out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/31a6f6852d47214d410f164561c12cccc38c0970.jpg[/img]

[*]Warriors now begin the game with -5 MDEF instead of 0. I know, I know, but honestly the Warrior was too OP. And it makes sense since he's already weak to magic as it is.

[*]The MORPH ability's success rate has been lowered to 30% + your MAG stat.

[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug where if you chose "no" when canceling a new game while a saved game exists and it erased the save file anyway. Holy crap I'm glad I caught this!!

[*]Fixed a double dip in the Cultist Den that had Pest Scrolls for sale for both 5 & 6 HP.
[/list]

---

I believe that's everything. I can't believe how much I've been working on this thing lately in my spare time however I feel this game is now 100% complete. I'm very proud of my game, which has gone from a little thing on the side to share with my kids to a huge and in-depth project that I play regularly for fun myself.

So tell your friends! The game is still on sale for less than a $1 right now weeeee hooooo! If you liked the game please by all means leave a review on the store page too. This game depends not only on good gameplay but on Steam-y word of mouth as well.

Thank you and Happy New Year!

Dave / Del_Duio

notes.title: Speed / Kills Update
notes.content:
And here's one that gives a big advantage to some monsters and a big advantage to the players!


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*]New enemy battle action: DEATH. Just like many of my favorite old games of yesteryear, ETL now has its own version of an instant death spell. Since it's so strong, only 2 enemies can cast it- The Reaper and Bob (the rare Shadow Chest boss). The chance to avoid being killed by this one is 50% + your MDEF score. You can also completely protect yourself 100% of the time if you have the Bless effect going . I guess this is extra good news for Clerics. 

[*]New player effect: SPEED BURST. This is a really awesome effect that I think you guys will enjoy. Characters under the Speed Burst effect can move 2 spaces to the enemies' 1 while walking around. In addition, while in battle you'll have a whopping 25% chance to gain another immediate action. And there is no cooldown phase either, so even after a free action you'd still get that 25% chance to get another one. That means you could potentially chain 2, 3, or 4+ attacks in a row upon the enemy! And if its possible, you'll gain a 100% chance to flee combat as well.

[*]If you're equipped with the Fist of Fury weapon, you'll constantly be under the battle effect side of Speed Burst. The weapon also stacks with the actual Speed Burst effect, making it way the hell better than it already was!
[/list]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*]Changed 3 of the guild tips from stuff we all already know to things we might not already know. Example being how on the class select screen it flat out tells you what special effect everybody gains like Bless, Nimble, etc.

[*]Spazz Weed now has a small chance to grant the new Speed Burst effect.

[*]Statues have a small chance to grant the new Speed Burst effect.

[*]You can 'use' the Elf Bow to gain Speed Burst from your backpack. Like most items there's a chance this will break when used.

[*]The Fist of Fury's 'use' effect was changed from Warrior Rage to Speed Burst. Like most items there's a chance this will break when used too.

[*]The Bless effect now has 2 listings on the 'Special' page: Curse Immunity and Death Magic Immunity.

[*]Lockpick chances for doors were lowered a bit for all classes, with the Thief still having the highest chance and the Cleric the lowest.

[*]Slightly changed the wider battle menu to look better. Improvement is key!
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

Nothing this time.


------

And that's that. I've updated the Boss guide to include the Death magic info and now that Warrior's Holy Cross looks a little bit better than it did before. ːsteamhappyː

Hey guys!

I was in the code trying to track down some bugs today and have added some things which I believe make the game better.

[h1]Item Usage Descriptions[/h1]

Ever get an item and you USE it just to hear a little bleep or bloop and it disappears? What did it do? Was it good or bad? Not every item in the game actually told you what it did when it was used like this.

Well now they do!

These are especially good in case you use a cursed item- to gauge for negative and likely permanent effects. In rare cases where more than one aspect has been changed (Ex. maybe your HP is increased but you lose STR) the guy will say that his "vitals feel off". This doesn't happen much but that's what it means if you see it.

These special messages have also been extended for things that you know what they do as well. Drink a red or green potion and your guy will tell you all about it. 

--

[h1]New Debugger Code[/h1]

And also new ETL player BluePsion had a bug pop up where his guy was trapped and surrounded by walls with no means of escape. Even if this never happens to you one time is one time too many, and this new debugger is just the tool I'll need to better help you with.

[b]To access it, from the main play screen press "Z" and then "9". [/b]

You will hear a little DING and see something like "Code # 200". If you're playing the game and happen to get stuck like this guy did, please give me this debug code which will greatly help me track down and fix the problem for everyone quickly.

It's important to note that if you quit / save and continue / reload the old file the debugger code will be set to 120 and no good to me. So if you get stuck, please get this code BEFORE quitting and saving. That's really important if this is going to work for all of us.

Thanks and I hope you never have to use this thing!

---

P.S: Today's daily bonus is for thieves and they'll start with 2 yellow potions right out of the gate.

Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Version 1.4 is here!!
notes.content:
Equin: The Lantern, perhaps Steam's biggest bang for your buck (and for some of you literally a friggin' buck haha), has now ammased enough updates for an official V1.4 tag!!

Thanks for all of your support in making my roguelike a popular and well-received one here up on Steam ːsteamhappyː

Here's what's new:

----------------------------

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]

[*]Start New Game and Continue Game are now both separate choices on the main menu. If you decide to start a new game while you have an existing save, it will let you know the old save will be deleted and ask if you really want to go ahead.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1221016420
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1221019522

[*]Upon starting a new game, your guy will tell you "Don't forget to equip my stuff!"

[*]Secret passages are now in the game! They are rare but out there, and look identical to normal walls. You will be able to walk right through them. If you're equipped with the new Goggles item the secret passages will have green sparklies.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1221011790

[*]Dimensional Rifts are now in the game! From floors 41+ you will sometimes see these glowing portals. With each step there is a 1% chance for various enemies to come out of them, including champs and possibly even bosses.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1221013604

[*]20 new items have been added to the game, increasing the total amount of items to 360. They are: Goggles, Dirty Fork, Sling Shot, Vine Crossbow, Weebish Flail, Raincoat, Dunce Cap, Pimp Hat, Orb of Out, Corrosive Mace, Buckler of Boom, Dodge Ball, Gloves of Evasion, War Pick, Oak Barrel, Grab Bag, Metal Detector, Wizard's Spear, Crappy Armor, Bush Disguise.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1221015837

[*]New sprite for the character when they're wearing the Bush Disguise.

[*]22 new base maps have also been added to the game, 15 of which were designed by ETL player X-Kirby and used with permission. Thank you!

[*]The PRAY skill now has a battle effect for clerics

[/list]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]

[*]The main menu has been completely restructured to fit the new 'continue game' option in.

[*]You can now unselect your starting gifts in case you change your mind. You cannot unselect your 3rd or final gift however as it still brings you to the starting bonus screen.

[*]The Reaper / Quiet Floor events can now no longer be on floors 30,40, or 50.

[*]Killer Plants can now no longer spawn any earlier than the 3rd floor.

[*]The Hero (orange tag) gear has been added to a slightly lower tier loot pool.

[*]Max Auto Kill rank has been capped at 4.

[*]Rol's Hat -> Evasion increased to 12%.

[*]Cloak of Evasion -> Evasion increased to 10%.

[*]The True Magic Shield was added to the special shop's possible stock for wizards.

[*]The "X" / close button on the windows header has been disabled to avoid players accidentally erasing their saves. To properly exit while playing, just select "QUIT" from the menu (which still saves your progress for next time).

[*]The Items Found Log has been increased in size to 18 pages to cover the new items.

[*]Title screen date changed to 2017.

[/list]


[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]

[*]The Reaper's Scythe now properly grants the +1 Auto Kill ability.

[*]The Thanksgiving Day daily bonus dates were corrected.

[*]Wizards can now equip the True Magic Shield, which was an oversight.

[*]Fixed it where you could warp into the new dead trees and possibly get stuck.
[/list]

Thanks, and see you next time!
Del_Duio

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE 2017
notes.content:
I should really just relax and enjoy my damn Thanksgiving lol...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/bf9770bce9a9728d77c5c2ae4b4583bc88fa011e.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*]Three more inventory slots for your backpack. More room is always good!

[*]A purple "SKILL" text now floats above the character upon hitting levels 4 and 7, reminding new players that they've just learned a new combat skill.

[*]New Boss: "Bob", a Shadow Chest death machine. Can rarely appear in place of the Golden Dragon on Floor 40 (see entry on the Boss Guide for further info)

[*]New Boss: "Consruct", a rock golem. Very difficult and hits like a truck. Can sometimes be found stalking the Icebox Floors (see entry on the Boss Guide for further info)

[*]Want new maps? You get 8 new maps! More variety is hoorah!

[*]The Ninja boss now has an uncommon black-suited variant. His stats are exactly the same as the white-suited version, only he also carries the Shadow Garb on him which is very awesome thief armor.

[*]Darkness & Icebox floor events now have their penalties show up on the Special screen.

[*]Graphical improvement: Vines on the shop & guild screens.

[*]New slogans when starting a new game up.

[*]Graphical improvement: The start up screen looks way better now IMO.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26672817/173ecd5e22b51cd27628cdb6f54d148a649bd090.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*]Many of the cursor selects in the game now 'wrap around', ex. press left all the way to have it appear on the right side and all that. Pretty handy.

[*]The Plant King boss can now also summon Killer Plants to his side.

[*]Gold display on the Self screen was changed from "GD" to "GOLD". Also the amount of gold is now displayed in golden text instead of black.

[/list]


[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*]If the character is injured while invisible he is no longer stuck in mid flash anymore. Hoorah!

[*]Gaining multiple levels in a row from a large source of XP now spaces them out, allowing you to see individual HP and STM gains.

[*]Tome (Mage) now correctly displays the STM reduction cost for spells on the Special screen.

[*]There's this one friggin' pixel that gets recolored during the battle pop up screen for like 5 years... I finally fixed it lol.

[*]Equin's Axe now has the full item description if it appears in a Shop / Cultist.

[/list]

--

And that's about it. 
Adding to the game and making it better sure is fun. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Thanksgiving Update!
notes.content:
And it's a friggin' doozy ːsteamhappyː

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor elemental effects SINGE, CHILL, and SPARK were added to some weapons. These act like mini versions of the Wizard spells FLAMES, ICE, and ZAP. Now classes other than Wizards can have access to these never-missing magics.

[*]New Obstacle: Locked Doors. From floors 15+ you may encounter a door with a huge lock on it. Any class can attempt to pick the lock, with Thieves being the best at it and Clerics the worst. If you are unsuccessful don't worry it's not like chests and there's no trap damage. Locked doors are there to slow you down, as each lockpick failure advances a turn and therefore monsters may close in on you faster.

[*]New boss monster, the Fuzzy Chicken! Little and cute, this guy rarely shows up on floor 10 in place of the Troll. Unlike the Troll he has many magical attacks and worth much more XP if defeated. I've also updated the Steam Boss Guide with this guy's stats and etc.

[*]New enemy battle option: ROAR. This mighty roar increases enemy attack power by 50% (can only be used once per battle). Some enemies and several bosses now have this.

[*]Enemies now have their own little buff / debuff icons in battle. These appear on the right side of the screen beneath their HUD display and are pretty helpful.

[*]Dead trees will now start to appear from floors 35+

[*]More daily bonuses added, including Thanksgiving Day.

[*]Many new stats and etc appear on the "Special" screen now, including the exact XP bonus provided by having a full Hit Streak gauge.

[*]The more money you have, the higher odds a shop will appear on the next floor now. The big thresholds to watch for are $2000, $5000, and $10000. Otherwise the shop spawn rate remains unchanged.
[/list]


[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Max enemy spawn count was slightly reduced (from map size / 20 to map size / 25). Though Equin The Lantern has tons of combat in it, I wanted to streamline it a bit more like the Auto Kill feature did before. To balance things out, all enemies are worth +50% more XP now. Each fight counts more.

[*]Campfire Sets can now be set up in more places than they used to. So aside from a clean dirt spot you can set them up on top of empty barrels, chests, pots and patches of grass to name a few. Thanks ErikaUnlimited for the idea to do this!

[*]Spazz Weed pots now have improved graphics. Those always bugged me!

[*]Using an Unlocking Scroll will now open any locked doors as well as trapped chests.

[*]Using a Pest Scroll will now kill any trees and change them into the new Dead Tree sprites.

[*]The Warrior's Glove now has a +1% critical hit chance to it.

[*]Changed Tip #70 to- "Many items and weapons can be used while still in your backpack. Experiment!" And it's true. Everyone should be doing this a little haha..
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
None this time.
[/list]

--

Everybody have a safe and happy holiday season!

notes.content:
Hello again, time for some more cool things!


[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]

*All shields now gain a chance to block. Whenever a monster goes to physically hit you and you're equipped with a shield you'll have a chance to totally negate any damage. *The Warrior's HUNKER skill now also grants an extra 5% chance to block if you're using a shield. Now I have to go an update my guide!

*The space bar / action button "Action" text that appears on the bottom RH screen was made a little easier to notice the flashing of it all. 


[h1]FIXES[/h1]

*Super user ErickaUnlimited had a re-occurring glitch that'd happen sometimes where upon entering a shop it'd freeze up and glitch. I did a lot of testing on this myself and was unable to duplicate the glitch BUT I also added some failsafes which I believe should help avoid this problem should it happen again.

*All the special purple tag items show the correct text colors when equipped and highlighted on the backpack screen.

---

Well that's about it for this time. Thanks to Ericka for discovering that shop glitch, as it got me to do all of this new stuff too ːsteamhappyː

Until next time!

notes.title: Re-Rebalancing Act
notes.content:
Hello!

I've made some slight yet important changes to the game in the never-ending quest to achieve perfect balance (and all that jazz).

[h1]Starting Bonus Tweaks[/h1]

I took a good look at which starting bonuses I really never chose much and made them better. So now two of them got a boost:

Attack Power +1 is now Attack Power +2
Magic Defense +2 is now Magic Defense +3

Again, slight but it makes a difference.


[h1]Reality Bites[/h1]

I was looking at my floor event guide and thought: Wouldn't it just plain make more sense if your shovel broke upon the hard icy ground of an Icebox floor? Well now it does. It's a bit more realistic when you think about it.


[h1]Monster Boosts[/h1]

Some monsters also got either an increased chance to use an existing ability or a new ability altogether:

[list]
[*]Chest Monsters now have an increased chance of casting the SLEEP spell
[*]Centiswords now have a chance to POISON on strike
[*]Skeleton Warriors now have an ICE magic spell to use
[/list]


[h1]Moolah Mania[/h1]

And finally, all chest monsters and death boxes got a big boost to how much money they can drop when killed. This should make a pretty big difference if you kill a bunch of them.

--

A big hello to all our new players brought in from the Summer Sale! In case you haven't already, please check out the game's helpful guides which are.. ah, HELPFUL.

Au revoir!

notes.title: Super Mega Update!
notes.content:
Oh man, finally!

As some of you may know, I've had a lot of internet connection issues this past week (and in fact am on a borrowed line right now for a few minutes). And I've been waiting to release this big update which will go a long way into making the Widescreen version...

*THE DEFINITIVE VERSION*

So, what did I do to it?

[h1]A redesigned "SELF" screen[/h1]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=935787123

This screen has always bugged me and now finally I can say I am completely happy with what it looks like now. Not only are things cooler-looking, like stats are close together now (STR, MAG, DEX, CON) and even a wee bit color-coded. And those colors mean something, folks!

[h1]I replaced the STATS screen with the SPECIAL screen[/h1]

Now bear with me here: Upon further review, I was looking at the game with a more critical eye. I thought that I wanted to make better use of the screen space available, and to do that I wanted to do away with any redundancy where possible. And since your guy's Graveyard file lists stuff like fish caught, items broken, kills and etc. It was sort of stupid to have all this stuff listed on the STATS screen too. Especially since I almost never looked at it while playing over the 1000s of hours or whatever.

Here is the new result:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=935786905

The SPECIAL screen will show you every effect in play that also doesn't give away andy of the Lantern's hidden powers on the game. So every effect like say Resist Fire will be shown here in text as well. 

BUT I went a big step forward with this and ran with it so now this screen also shows the auxially effects from your equipped gear as well! For example, equip a Short bow and now you'll be able to see its bonuses to your Hit and Crit%. Equip too many heavy items with a DEX penalty and you'll be able to see any acrued negatives to your Hit% or chances of running away.

And now you'll all finally get to see stuff that's been in the game the whole time. For example did you guys know that every hammer-class weapon in the game has a +3% chance to land a critical hit? Equip the Putrine dagger and on this screen you'll see that it has an inherrent "Poison damage on strike" effect. Even your starter bonuses can be listed here. All in all, this screen is a huge improvement and I'm looking at it far more than the old one.

[h1]Burned Gear Display[/h1]

But that's not all. Now when your wooden equipped gear gets hit by an enemy fire spell in battle some giant flashing words pop up to warn you that you're now punching things to death. As dumb as it sounds, this should've been in there from the beginning but I never got around to doing it before now.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]These have been addressed

[*]There was a chance to get a floor load error due to the new map additions I put in the other week. I tested this further and got the same error. There's now a failsafe in case this specific error happens again and this has been tested and works. You should all be good!

[*]If you have a cursed helmet equipped the text display is now red like it should've been before.

[*]The "NO" icon wasn't showing up on some two handed weapons before. And now it does!

[*]Recolored the campfire set & floor spikes so that the browns don't show up on Icebox floor events.

[*]Some of the texts were moved around on the shop screens to look better.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

And as always I want to thank everybody still playing my game! Between tonight's updates and the recent other improvements (Widescreen, Pack 18) I think this is the very best version of my favorite game I've made. And I'm just happy I was able to borrow this wifi to deliver it all TO YOU!

[b]And now I gotta' get out of this guy's trash cans before I'm discovered![/b]

-Del_Duio

notes.title: The Level 10 Update!
notes.content:
Hello again!

Wow it's been a whole THREE DAYS without adding anything more to the game has it? That's FAR TOO LONG. Without further hesitation I present to you all...

(drumroll...)

[b]The Level 10 Update[/b]

[i]Additions:[/i]

At character level 10 all 3 classes now gain another rank to their Auto Kill ability. And a colorful new look. Oh, and this:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=809176382

A special Level 10 bonus pick. This is just like the one you get when you first select your character, only all of these are really good. But enough of that mumbo jumbo, allow me to demonstrate:


[b]NIGHTVISION[/b]

Nightvision allows for perfect vision during any dark floor events, making almost the entire field visible. While walking around in the "darkness" you will never be ambushed and gain a +15% chance to hit any enemy in combat. This goes for all your special weapon skills that normally have small penalties on them.


[b]LUCKY[/b]

If you choose to be a lucky sort of guy you will gain a bonus to spawn both Golden and Shadow chests from every floor here on out. The lucky bonus will stack with any other inherent floor event bonus (ex. Treasure or Arena of Death floors).


[b]SKILL MASTERY[/b]

Lastly you can choose good ol' Skill Mastery. Characters with mastery can perform any of their normal 3 class skills with a -1 stamina cost. This can be incredibly useful if you like to use SLAY, STEAL, or ZAP while playing. And good news, Wizards: Mastery will stack with the Mage Tome, allowing you to fire off spells at a 2 point stamina reduction (!)


--

[i]Other additions:[/i]

New saleble item, the Zircon. You can sometimes mine these out of gold deposits in the walls. This has been added to the last slot of the current Items Found Log and will not interfere with your current journals.

--

I've figured out a cool way for the game to keep track of all the floors you've already cleared upon saving and continuing for later. This will keep any possible base maps from reappearing during any particular run down to a cool 0%. This is particularly nice if you plan on taking a break every 5-10 floors or whathaveyou.

--

I believe that is way more than enough for tonight, now I have to update the guides where applicable.

Thanks, and until next time!

notes.title: Player Feedback / Minor Update
notes.content:
I always listen to player feedback, and very often it leads to improvements in my games. For ETL we got better in-game volume controls and tonight we have a couple more tweaks:

[b]Hypothetical Scenario #1: [/b]

So you open a barrel and get- what else?- a banana! So your little text pop up tells you as much and as you're walking south you suddenly run into a troll you couldn't see because the text pop up hadn't gone away yet.

Now you have the option to simply press the action button (or space bar) while the pop up is visible to close the thing right away if you want. No more unwanted surprises!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=791775929


[b]Hypothetical Scenario #2: [/b]

So you're on floor 38 with an inventory full of bananas and over $15,000 in cash. It's been ages since you've last seen a shop.. Suddenly, out of the darkness you see those famous blue sword signs! Excitedly you break for the door, money in hand, and drool as this time they have JUST the weapon that will carry you all the way to the end of the game!

-Only in your rush you totally forget that your backpack is CHOCK FULL OF BANANAS! Now you can't buy anything, and go into a DEEP DEPRESSION.

This will never happen to anyone now! There's now a failsafe in the game where you won't be able to enter a shop with a backpack full of 10 items!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=791772938

--

Thanks to Kevin Feederline for the great ideas, and thanks all of you for helping to make ETL a better experience for everybody. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Out right now! Here's what's new:
notes.content:
Here's some Equin: The Lantern general and helpful info (and sometimes both!)

A beginner's guide to help... Beginners!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=785661389
[b]Version 1.3ST Features [/b]
[list]
[*]Gamepad support
[*]Option to quit & save, then continue where you left off yet still keeps permadeath
[*]Brand new music in the old 8 bit style replaces all but the theme song
[*]New starting menu- including a way to see all your previously learned help tips from bribing the guild members
[*]Ability to unequip gear! Simply press UP on the subscreen to select your equipped gear to remove! 
[*]Players have a WAIT command now to skip a turn
[*]New floor Icebox floor event
[*]Improved the stealing odds for the Thief Class
[*]Improved the fleeing odds for every class
[*]Jail cells- Open at your own risk! 
[*]Wizard's magic spells 'ICE' and 'ZAP' got a big damage boost
[*]Two Handed weapons system completely overhauled (finally, woo hoo!) 
[*]Bless effect reworked so you can continuously equip and remove cursed items if you really wanted to 
[*]Warrior's Glove is no longer mandatory and in fact was given a buff to DEF 1, STM +2
[*]Every character now begins with 3 starting gifts instead of 2
[*]New obstacle- Spider Webs. Both you and the enemy can get caught in them 
[*]Fire Floors damage reduced from 2 to 1
[*]Flowers can appear and can be eaten
[*]Mushrooms can now grow on both darkness and rainy floors. You can eat them but they might poison you! 
[*]Player skills DODGE and HUNKER now have a visual icon that appears in the effects HUD 
[*]If you've been shield bashed by the enemy there's now a visual icon that also appears in the effects HUD
[*]Gain the auto kill ability at higher levels to walk into weaker enemies and instantly kill them without entering combat
[*]New statues that can teleport you to another section of the floor 
[*]The ghost now randomly appears on graveyard floors instead of always being there
[*]Dungeon walls change color and there's new music for every 10 floors reached
[*]Extra décor about the place (blood-splattered walls, various grasses and floor stones, etc) 
[/list]
